workLog.summary: Added a merged-history discriminator to check_branch_context. The mismatch is exempt only when the branch owns a recent session log AND the newest log already exists on the upstream default branch, which makes it settled history rather than a claim about current work. Fails closed with no resolvable origin/HEAD, so the issue #682 co-mingling case keeps its teeth.
